scenes.bubble: Reverse charge? We still invoice ourselves.
scenes.caption: Reverse‑charge purchases.
scenes.say: Myth or fact? Under the reverse charge, you still have to issue an invoice to yourself.
cap: Under the *reverse charge*, you still have to issue an invoice to *yourself*.

scenes.head: Self‑invoice replaced
scenes.src: UAE Ministry of Finance news, 3 Dec 2025: Federal Decree‑Law No. 16 of 2025 amending the VAT Law, effective 1 Jan 2026; checked 29 Oct 2026. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: Myth. Since the first of January twenty twenty-six, taxable persons no longer need to issue self-invoices under the reverse charge. The reverse charge still applies; they keep the supporting documents instead.
cap: Since *1 January 2026*, taxable persons no longer need to issue *self‑invoices* under the reverse charge.
The reverse charge still applies; they keep the *supporting documents* instead.

scenes.say: So check your process and your year-end V.A.T. file: the documents need to be there.
cap: So check your process and your *year‑end VAT file*: the documents need to be there.
